entries.claim: The pinned Latin Mass data supply a derived digital comparison reading for this component. They are not an independent printed witness of the controlling 1962 edition. Exact source readings and declared framing remain separately attributable.

locator.section: Postcommunion above Feria Tertia; accented relative conclusion through Deus

entries.claim: The accented formula middle supplies w026–w035 and w039–w041. It has no comma after Christum, prints tuum: Qui and Sancti, Deus. The selected eiusdem is supplied by the Pentecost proper cue and RG 115 e, not by an unprinted eiusdem here. Printed Deus. is reintegrated as Deus, before the terminal duration.

locator.section: Top chant line: Per omnia saecula saeculorum and response Amen

entries.claim: The printed terminal formula and response supply w042–w046. Chant syllable divisions are joined, the response marker is excluded, and uppercase Per becomes selected per. This textual use does not by itself determine the modeled ritual voice.

locator.section: Proper body w001–w023, abbreviated Per Dominum cue w024–w025 and in unitate eiusdem cue w036–w038; the missing formula middle and terminal response are separately expanded.

entries.claim: The identified proper page prints the bounded body and abbreviated cues described in the locator, not the whole contiguous expanded selected text. Same-edition formula/rule dependencies and house reintegration are separately declared in the witness record.

locator.section: Rubricae generales 115 a; Father-addressed full conclusion

entries.claim: RG 115 a supplies the Father-addressed conclusion rule and Amen. Its unaccented rubric typography is not a direct witness to every selected accent or house punctuation seam.

locator.section: Rubricae generales 115 e; same Spirit in the conclusion

entries.claim: The Collect names the Holy Spirit in its body. RG 115 e requires in unitate eiusdem Spiritus Sancti. The proper cue on p350 positively supplies accented eiusdem; this rule establishes applicability, not that accent.

locator.section: RG 480–481, 511 d/i, 513–514; Ordo Missae rubric and chant formula after the secrets

entries.claim: The final secret has an audible Per omnia saecula saeculorum followed by the response Amen. Collects and postcommunions are priestly orations with a separate response. These rules determine the modeled boundaries, not the completeness of a date-specific commemoration inventory.
